inference_substrate.principle: Scores cached traces; no LLM load.

collapse_detected_deploy_arm.principle: The conservative-default rule must prevent self-distillation collapse (alpha_t grounding).

collapse_detected_control_beta0.principle: Positive control: the unguarded arm must collapse, else the test has no contrast.

factual_verifier_calibration_improved.principle: The forward difference — online calibration of the new factual detector via the deployed rule.

pass_rate_vs_true_accuracy_distinct_asse.principle: De-flags the tautology where pass_rate and true_accuracy are the same array.

quality_maintained.principle: Collapse-prevention must not come at the cost of detector quality.
